ideas.pitch: A federated model router and governance audit log built specifically to process and verify participant code submissions and PRs submitted to the 3SVK portal.
ideas.title: 3SVK Research Cloud-Native Agent Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core workflow of the 3SVK Ecosystem Platform team who are actively processing 4,000+ GitHub PRs and code audits during the evaluation window.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first, local model execution pipeline that audits code repositories for vulnerabilities and compliance without sending student source code to external servers.
ideas.title: SVK-NPU Offline Code Security Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the demand for secure, local processing of sensitive research code submissions matching student ecosystem growth tracks.

ideas.pitch: A self-improving semantic retrieval engine that indexes student abstracts from the 3SVK research portal, automatically routing submissions to the most relevant peer reviewers using vector embeddings.
ideas.title: Semantic Peer Review Index for Student Research
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the scaling bottleneck of reviewing thousands of research papers and project submissions submitted to the 3SVK ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: A compliance and pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool that maps student startup applications to strict evaluation criteria and automated BPMN governance flows.
ideas.title: BPMN-Orchestrated Student Innovation Workflow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with enterprise-track expansion goals by introducing rigorous, automated business process management to student startup mentorship pipelines.

ideas.pitch: Two specialized AI agents that independently evaluate and debate the novelty of student research proposals, refining their grading rubric iteratively through self-play.
ideas.title: Self-Optimizing Agentic Research Evaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced self-improving agent capabilities, directly addressing the continuous research opportunities promoted by the organizers.
